# /draw reference index

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/lookup.py --render-index` from `references/index.json`. Do not edit by hand: edit index.json and regenerate. -->

The book index of the draw skill: topic id — title — file § chapter (→ row, item or line range). Look a topic up with `python3 "<skill>/scripts/lookup.py" <topic-id> --log "<project>/.claude/draw/<slug>"`, which prints only that chapter and appends the lookup to `<slug>/docs/lookups.log`; `python3 "<skill>/scripts/lookup.py" <words>` lists candidate ids. Aliases follow a topic in brackets.
